name: @nosdesk/plugin-runtime
description: The Vue-free iframe runtime for Nosdesk sandboxed plugins: establishes the host bridge, imports the token-authorized bundle, mounts it.

scripts.build: esbuild src/runtime.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --banner:js='// GENERATED from @nosdesk/plugin-runtime src/runtime.ts by `pnpm --filter @nosdesk/plugin-runtime build`. Do not edit by hand; CI drift-checks it.' --outfile=../../backend/src/handlers/plugin_sandbox/runtime.js
